extracted.intended_audience: securities exchanges, market participants, investors, and securities-law practitioners (interested persons commenting on SEC filings)
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation and regulatory standards for a proposed rule change to list and trade shares of a commodity-based trust (spot ETH ETF) on an exchange under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), including listing criteria, surveillance, custody, valuation, disclosure, and trading rules used by the SEC and the Exchange. Intended to guide approval/disapproval and public comment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 19(b)(1) and Rule 19b-4 filing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed rule change filed pursuant to Section 19(b)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 19b-4; the Commission publishes notice to solicit comments on the proposed rule change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing must include Items I, II, and III prepared by the Exchange; text of the proposed rule change must be made available on the Exchange's website, at the Exchange's Office of the Secretary, and at the Commission's Public Reference Room.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commodity-Based Trust Shares initial and continued listing criteria (Rule 14.11(e)(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: As defined in Rule 14.11(e)(4)(C)(i), Shares must be (a) issued by a trust that holds a specified commodity deposited with the trust; (b) issued by such trust in a specified aggregate minimum number in return for a deposit of a quantity of the underlying commodity; and (c) when aggregated in the same specified minimum number, may be redeemed at a holder's request by such trust which will deliver to the redeeming holder the quantity of the underlying commodity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All statements regarding description of the portfolio, limitations on holdings, and applicability of Exchange rules constitute continued listing requirements; the Exchange will obtain a representation that the Trust's NAV will be calculated daily and that these values and information about the assets will be made available to all market participants at the same time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trustee qualifications and change notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Trustee must be a trust company having substantial capital and surplus and the experience and facilities for handling corporate trust business as required under Rule 14.11(e)(4)(E)(iv)(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No change will be made to the trustee without prior notice to and approval of the Exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange and agent non-liability for commodity value dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to Rule 14.11(e)(4)(F), neither the Exchange nor any agent of the Exchange shall have any liability for damages, claims, losses or expenses caused by any errors, omissions or delays in calculating or disseminating any underlying commodity value or the current value required to be deposited to the Trust.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This includes errors resulting from negligent acts or any act, condition or cause beyond reasonable control of the Exchange (acts of God, equipment or software malfunction, communications or power failure, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered Market Maker reporting and trading restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Under Rule 14.11(e)(4)(G), any registered market maker in the Shares must file with the Exchange and keep current a list identifying all accounts for trading in an underlying commodity, related commodity futures or options on commodity futures, or other related commodity derivatives which the registered market maker may have or over which it may exercise investment discretion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No registered Market Maker shall trade in an underlying commodity, related futures, or related derivatives in an account not reported to the Exchange; must make available books, records or other information pertaining to such transactions as requested by the Exchange (including transactions by affiliated employees for own accounts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily NAV calculation and definition
rubrics_metrics.description: NAV means total assets of the Trust (including ETH and cash, if any) less total liabilities, each determined on the basis of generally accepted accounting principles; the Administrator will determine the NAV each day the Exchange is open for regular trading as promptly as practical after 4:00 p.m. EST.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In determining NAV, the Administrator values the ETH held by the Trust based on the price set by the Benchmark as of 4:00 p.m. EST and determines NAV per Share.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intraday Indicative Value (IIV) and transparency requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trust will provide an IIV per Share updated every 15 seconds during the Exchange's Regular Trading Hours; IIV is calculated using prior day's closing NAV as a base and updated to reflect intraday changes in Trust's ETH holdings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IIV should not be viewed as an actual real-time NAV (NAV calculated once daily). The IIV will be widely disseminated by major market data vendors; the Trust's website will publish current NAV per Share, prior business day's NAV, BZX Official Closing Price relation to NAV, charts of premium/discount distributions for the prior four quarters (or life of Trust), the prospectus, holdings daily, and other quantitative information. Benchmark methodology will be publicly available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benchmark design and methodology (Lukka Prime Reference Rate)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trust will use the Lukka Prime Reference Rate as the Benchmark to calculate NAV; the Benchmark is designed to be a robust price for ETH in USD with no component other than ETH and uses eligible exchanges sourced by the Benchmark Provider.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmark Provider uses a five-step weighting process: (1) assign Base Exchange Score (BES) for static characteristics; (2) adjust BES by relative monthly volume to get Volume Adjusted Score (VAS); (3) decay adjusted score based on time since last trade to produce Decayed Volume Adjusted Score (DVAS); (4) rank exchanges by DVAS and designate highest as Principal Market; (5) use an executed exchange price at 4:00 p.m. Eastern time to represent fair market value. Provider reviews eligible exchanges quarterly and uses proprietary ratings criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and dissemination of ETH price and trading data
rubrics_metrics.description: Quotation and last-sale information for ETH is widely disseminated through major market data vendors (Bloomberg, Reuters) and the Benchmark; price of ETH will be made available by one or more major market data vendors, updated at least every 15 seconds during Regular Trading Hours; depth of book and trading information on ETH exchanges are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quotation and last-sale information regarding the Shares will be disseminated through the facilities of the Consolidated Tape Association (CTA); normal trading hours for ETH exchanges are 24/7, and Trust's NAV will be calculated once daily.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custodian duties and cold storage/segregation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The ETH Custodian's services allow deposit from and withdrawal to public blockchain addresses; the Custody Agreement requires the Custodian to hold the Trust's ETH in cold storage (unless temporarily needed for withdrawals) and to use segregated cold storage ETH addresses separate from addresses for other customers and directly verifiable via the ETH blockchain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Custodian must safeguard the private keys to the Trust's ETH, record and identify that such ETH is property of the Trust in its books and records, and not withdraw, loan, hypothecate, pledge, or otherwise encumber the Trust's ETH without the Trust's instruction. If custody agreement terminates, Sponsor may appoint another custodian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation and redemption procedures and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Authorized participants may place orders to create one or more Creation Baskets on any business day; purchase orders must be placed by 4:00 p.m. ET or the close of regular trading, whichever is earlier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total deposit of ETH required is proportional to total assets net of accrued expenses and liabilities as of the purchase order date; the Sponsor publishes nightly the amount of ETH required per creation order; Administrator determines required deposit by dividing ETH held at opening of business (adjusted for estimated accrued fees) by (shares outstanding/opening business ÷ 5,000). Redemption procedures mirror creation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trading halts and factors for suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: The Exchange may consider all relevant factors in halting or suspending trading in the Shares and will halt trading under conditions specified in BZX Rule 11.18.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trading may be halted because of market conditions or reasons making trading inadvisable, including: (1) extent to which trading is not occurring in the ETH underlying the Shares; or (2) other unusual conditions or circumstances detrimental to the maintenance of a fair and orderly market. Trading also subject to Rule 14.11(e)(4)(E)(ii) circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of Shares as equity securities and trading rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The Exchange deems the Shares to be equity securities so trading in the Shares is subject to the Exchange's existing rules governing equity securities and will be allowed during all trading sessions on the Exchange.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minimum price variation for quoting and entry of orders is $0.01 where the price is > $1.00 per share or $0.0001 where the price is < $1.00 per share (BZX Rule 11.11(a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Surveillance procedures and surveillance-sharing agreement requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission has historically approved or disapproved exchange filings to list and trade Trust Issued Receipts on the basis of whether the listing exchange has a comprehensive surveillance-sharing agreement with a regulated market of significant size related to the underlying commodity to be held.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joint membership in the Intermarket Surveillance Group (ISG) has been recognized as constituting such a surveillance-sharing agreement. The Exchange may obtain information regarding trading in the Shares and ETH Futures via ISG or from other exchanges with which it has a comprehensive surveillance sharing agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significant market test for related regulated market
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'regulated market of significant size' includes a market (or group of markets) where: (a) there is a reasonable likelihood that a person attempting to manipulate the ETP would also have to trade on that market to manipulate the ETP (so that surveillance-sharing would assist detection/deterrence); and (b) it is unlikely that trading in the ETP would be the predominant influence on prices in that market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This test guides whether a related regulated market (e.g., CME ETH Futures) can support approval via surveillance-sharing; metrics such as volume, open interest, number of unique accounts, and correlation to spot are relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative means to prevent fraudulent and manipulative acts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission has recognized that the 'regulated market of significant size' standard is not the only means to satisfy Section 6(b)(5); an exchange could demonstrate that 'other means to prevent fraudulent and manipulative acts and practices' are sufficient to justify dispensing with the requisite surveillance-sharing agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples discussed include geographic diversity and continuous nature of ETH trading, fragmentation across platforms, presence of arbitrageurs, high correlation between spot and futures, and CME's surveillance capabilities; the Exchange must demonstrate why these means mitigate manipulation concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 6(b)(5) standards — fraud prevention and investor protection
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission must determine that the proposed listing is consistent with Section 6(b)(5) of the Act, specifically that exchange rules are designed to prevent fraudulent and manipulative acts and practices and are designed to protect investors and the public interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exchange filings must demonstrate how the proposal meets these statutory requirements and how manipulation concerns are mitigated relative to investor protection benefits of the product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Circular and prospectus delivery obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior to the commencement of trading, the Exchange will inform its members in an Information Circular of special characteristics and risks of trading the Shares and advise members of prospectus delivery requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Information Circular will discuss: (i) creation and redemption procedures and that Shares are not individually redeemable; (ii) BZX Rule 3.7 suitability obligations when recommending Shares; (iii) how IIV and NAV are disseminated; (iv) risks of trading outside Regular Trading Hours when updated IIV will not be available; (v) requirement to deliver a prospectus to investors purchasing newly issued Shares prior to or concurrently with confirmation; and (vi) any exemptive, no-action, and interpretive relief granted by the Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delisting procedures for noncompliance with listing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Trust or the Shares are not in compliance with applicable listing requirements, the Exchange will commence delisting procedures under Exchange Rule 14.12.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issuer has represented it will advise the Exchange of any failure by the Trust or Shares to comply with continued listing requirements; Exchange surveils for compliance under Section 19(g)(1) of the Exchange Act.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of CME ETH Futures as a related regulated market of significant size (supporting evidence)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Exchange and Sponsor assert the CME ETH Futures market represents a regulated market of significant size as it relates to CME ETH Futures and the spot ETH market, citing metrics (e.g., trading volume, open interest, increase in unique accounts) and high correlation between spot ETH and CME ETH Futures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The filing references CME's surveillance and the precedent of using a regulated futures market as the related market when approving commodity-based trust shares; provides data (e.g., contract counts, dollar value, correlation 0.998) to support the claim.
